summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) on October 6, 2026, disclosing routine daily ASX reporting under its existing stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate acquisitions of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No price per share, premium, or transaction terms are stated; the filing reiterates management intent to repurchase from time to time, subject to market price, general market conditions, securities laws, and alternative investment opportunities. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 contain the ASX disclosures dated therein. Watch for continued buyback pace, remaining authorization capacity, and any acceleration signaling management's valuation view.
